content.Title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
content.Section: Risk Factors and Associated Heart Disease
content.Details: The guideline presents evidence for factors contributing to atrial fibrillation (AF) from single studies, meta-analyses, and Mendelian randomization studies. Risk factors include demographic, anthropometric, cardiovascular risk factors, CVD, noncardiac conditions, biomarkers, and genetic markers.
